title: Nobody Noticed. The Spotlight Effect Explained
text:
In a 2000 study by Thomas Gilovich and colleagues, students wearing an embarrassing T-shirt into a room guessed about half of their peers noticed it. Only about a quarter actually did. It's called the spotlight effect: we overestimate how much others notice our looks and slips.

Send this to a friend who overthinks everything.
